intro.text: Some LFIs asked us to go further than SWIFT — trimming the set to a stricter subset (e.g. A–Z 0–9 space - / ) to guarantee a reference survives every core and rail intact. We acknowledge that concern, but we do not think the answer is to technically limit the field further in Open Finance. Narrowing the validated set would reject ordinary references such as Salary (June) or Ref: 9981, paid for everyone. Instead, survivability is best handled through the Structured Reference guidance — helping TPPs choose which characters to prefer and which to avoid — while the enforced validation stays at the full ISO 20022 / SWIFT “x” set.

A single, additive change — a character-set pattern on the current free-text reference schemas — applied identically wherever the reference appears. The 35-character limit and free-text-first shape are unchanged; the deprecated structured variants are not touched.
